test_title: PYST 46: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn an interest of ₹420 in 2 years at 5% simple interest per year?
solution:
**Given:**

Interest (SI) = ₹420

Time = 2 years

Rate of Interest = 5% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Principal = (SI × 100) / (Rate × Time)

**Calculation:**

Principal = (₹420 × 100) / (5 × 2)

⇒ Principal = ₹42000 / 10

⇒ Principal = ₹4200

**The sum that will earn an interest of ₹420 in 2 years at 5% simple interest per year is ₹4200.**
